content:
maya: Heads-up — product asked for trace-derived SLOs on inference latency (end-to-end + model-only). They want per-route dashboards and automatic alerting for burn rate. Any thoughts on how we should hook this into the current OTLP pipeline?
juan: love this. key things: we need consistent span naming/attributes (route, model.variant, cache.hit, queue.wait) so we can slice. do we have that today?
oliver: we do some of it but it's inconsistent. many internal services use `http.route` but not `redwood.route`. model workers emit `model_id` and `variant` but not a canonical `route`.
sam: for SLOs you really want tail-based sampling otherwise you miss p95/p99. our current reservoir sampling drops rare long tails.
maya: +1 on tail-based. any objections to adding a tail-sampler in the collector and exporting a separate sampled tail stream to clickhouse/tempo?
eden: curious on storage/cost. keeping all tail spans for 30d sounds expensive. could we keep full traces for only a small set of routes (high-volume or high-risk)?
juan: yes — tiered retention: full traces for canaries, high-error routes, and a p95-tail sample for everything else. cheap metrics (histograms) for longer retention.
oliver: implementation idea: Otel collector config with two exporters: tempo (7d full traces, short retention) + clickhouse/olap for aggregated and tail-sampled traces. processor: tail_sampling -> exporter to clickhouse.
sam: + code sketch:``` 
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [tail_sampling, batch]
      exporters: [tempo, clickhouse]
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policy:
      latency:
        goal_latency: 500ms
        num_traces: 200
``` 
maya: that snippet is useful. we also need stable keys for sampling decision (trace attributes). set decision on route+model.variant so canary traces are sticky.
eden: and add a `sampling.reason` tag so downstream UIs know why it was sampled (tail vs rule vs default).
juan: for dashboards: Panel idea: SLO summary card per-route (p50/p90/p95/p99), error budget %, burn rate sparkline, last 30d histogram. clicking SLO drills into trace waterfall with spans colored by stage (ingress/queue/model/infer/cache).
sam: UX request: Console rollouts page should show current SLOs for new variant and automatically gate canary if burn rate > 2x for 10m. we already have rollout hooks — need an API that accepts a trace SLO verdict.
maya: agreed. technical: we need a service that consumes metrics derived from traces (histograms) and exposes SLO evaluation. Do we want to compute SLOs on the metrics pipeline (Prometheus/TSDB) or compute from traces on-demand?
oliver: compute SLOs in metrics TSDB is cheaper: exporter converts traces -> latency buckets and error counts per route/model, then Prom SLO evaluation. Keep raw traces for debugging.
eden: downside: converting to metrics loses correlation info (e.g., a request that hit a model variant and had cache miss). But for alerting, metrics are enough. For root cause, link to trace sample.
juan: agree. so flow: OTLP -> collector tail sampling + metric-aggregation processor -> export metrics to metricstore; traces to tempo/clickhouse. SLO service reads metrics.
maya: what about quotas? we want to attribute costs by route/model. include token_count span attribute so we can bucket cost per-route. dashboards should show cost per 1k requests and per-token.
sam: token_count already emitted by the runtime for every response. ensure collector aggregates `sum(token_count)` by route/model on export.
oliver: and for error budgets: define SLO as availability (error rate) + latency SLO (p95 < X ms). Burn policy: errors > threshold increment budget, latency violations counted via metric bucket > threshold.
eden: also think about anomaly detection: auto-create an incident if burn rate spikes and link to top 10 traces (by duration) in the last 15m.
maya: operational concern: sampling config changes need to be rollout-safe. add a feature flag + collector config versioning. collectors should gracefully accept config delta and emit a diff event in telemetry-bot.
telemetry-bot: collector-config v2 deployed to prod-telemetry (tail_sampling enabled for routes: /generate, /embed).
juan: nice. one more: low-cardinality keys only for metrics aggregation. high-cardinality attributes (user_id, prompt_hash) must be removed or hashed. add a cardinality-limiter processor to the collector.
sam: +1. also tag model.variant but only up to 50 variants per model; if more, collapse into `variant:other`.
oliver: last: dashboards — add a small waterfall breakdown panel that computes mean durations per stage and a stacked p95 bar for each route. colors: ingress=blue, queue=orange, model=green, cache=purple.
maya: I'll draft a PR with collector config and an SLO proposal doc. aim to land sampling + metrics export in 2 sprints.
eden: thanks — will help with cost calc and retention tiers.
juan: ping me when PR ready, I'll review the sampling heuristics.
telemetry-bot: created ticket INF-4523 "Trace-derived SLOs + tail sampling" and linked this thread. :lock:
